citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:05 AM on August
12, 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by phone and text message. The licensee returned the phone
call explaining they were were not available to accompany the APHIS official for inspection. Failure to provide access to
the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide
access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
